lines.en: Say, Joe, I had a strange idea after what we could do for our last night.
What do you say we play a little, uh, foosball for money?
Are you crazy? You haven't beaten me once since my injury-plagued 97 season.
It'd be easier if you just give me your money.
Ha-ha! That's like 500 bucks you owe me.
Yeah, $500. That is a lot of electricity, yeah?
Ooh, I gotta buy some food.
Okay, give me a chance to win my money back, okay?
Okay. Get ready to owe me.
No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no!
See? Now that's why only the little fake men are supposed to do the kicking.
We can play a new game. A new game. It's fun.
I don't know how to play cups.
I'll teach it. Come on, come on. It's really easy. Really, really fun.
I have two queens. What do you have?
Oh, yeah. Okay, let's play again. Ready?
Well, it doesn't matter. Nothing beats a three and a six.
Okay, now, how much have you won so far?
Yeah, see, in cups, once you get $700, you have to double it.
Hey, I didn't make up the rules.
Okay, so now, after you receive the doubling bonus, you get, uh, one card.
Now, that one card could be worth $100, which brings your total to $1,500.
Don't get too excited, because that's not gonna happen unless you get the...
Ross and I were helping the girls pack.
I lost $1,500 to them at cups.
How did you lose at cups?
I start out with the king and the queen.
Ross gets a two and a three.
Then I get a jack and a king.
Ross, it's a four and a five.
Maybe Ross was getting the cup card, the D-cup, the sitting down bonus.
Meanwhile, I didn't even get a half a cup.
I invented the game of cups as a way to give Joey money.
And now you want that money back.
Chandler, what kind of idiot do you take me for?
I'm sorry you lost your money, but I won it fair and square.
Now, if you want to try to make some of it back, I'd be glad to play you for it, but I should
warn you, I am very good at cups.
Now, I assume the saucer card came up when you played last.
Let's see if it comes up.
